_meta.title: Intelligence & Data domain graph — connectivity remediation (PROPOSAL ONLY)
_meta.purpose: Grounded feedback/reciprocal edges and redundant paths to remediate the findings from assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js (the audit module is domain-generic) run against assets/data/domains/intelligence.json. This is a recommendation artifact; it does NOT modify any live graph.
_meta.discipline: Every proposed edge carries a concrete grounding (a canonical-nodes.json regulatory/anatomical fact OR the reciprocity of an existing intelligence.json edge). Candidates that could not be grounded are omitted and tallied under _omittedForLackOfGrounding.
_meta.doNotApply: Do not merge these edges into assets/data/domains/intelligence.json without an explicit apply step.
_meta.neuroReferenceThesis: Healthy circuits are ~80% recurrent/lateral; the network, not the node, is the unit of failure (diaschisis). A pure feedforward tree is the broken/cosmetic version.
_meta.pathologyVerdict: SAME SIGNATURE AS FINANCE, plus the same extra fault. Intelligence carries directed control rings but almost no reciprocal feedback (recurrentFraction 0.032, a single reciprocal pair dACC<->dlPFC) and many single points of failure (11 articulation nodes). The EXTRA fault (shared with Finance, absent in Energy): the graph is fractured into 2 components at baseline — the {SMA, M1} motor dyad is fully disconnected from the 39-node main body. Intelligence-specific twist: the entire mesolimbic reward/valuation island {VTA, NAcc, VP, OFC} hangs off the main body by a SINGLE thread (OFC->vmPFC), which is why vmPFC, OFC and NAcc all appear as articulation points for the same cluster.

recurrenceAudit.note: Exactly ONE reciprocal pair exists: dACC<->dlPFC (dACC->dlPFC SUPPLIES + dlPFC->dACC excit), giving reciprocalEdges=2 and recurrentFraction 2/62=0.032. The graph carries directed cycles (the business-layer CONTROLS ring A1->EMP->V1->FPN->ECN->rACC->A1, and the SUPPLIES/DEPENDS_ON rings) but for essentially no edge A->B does B->A exist. verdict from the module = 'has recurrent/lateral structure' only because lateralFractionOfClassifiable (0.313) clears the 0.2 lateral threshold; the feedback dimension is all but absent — better than Finance's exact 0 but still far below the ~0.8 cortical benchmark.

singlePointsOfFailure.baseComponentsNote: TWO components at baseline. Main body = 39 nodes; a fully disconnected dyad = {SMA, M1} (only internal edge SMA->M1, no edge in or out of the main body). Same pre-existing fracture as Finance (Energy baseComponents=1).

mechanismOfEachArticulation.A1: sole attachment of the auditory relay leaf MGN (MGN->A1 is MGN's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.V1: sole attachment of the visual relay leaf LGN (LGN->V1 only) AND of FEF (FEF->V1 is FEF's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.dACC: sole bridge of the interoceptive island {AI, NTS, PI} to the main body — AI->dACC is that island's only link out.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.PVN: sole attachment of leaf HYPO (PVN->HYPO is the only edge into HYPO).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.vmPFC: sole bridge of the reward/valuation island {VTA, NAcc, VP, OFC} to the main body — OFC->vmPFC is that island's only link out.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.HIPP: sole attachment of leaf HPA (HPA->HIPP is HPA's only edge).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.THAL: sole attachment of leaf S1 (THAL->S1 only), of leaf CBLM (CBLM->THAL only), and of the basal-ganglia output pair {STRI, GP} (GP->THAL is that pair's only link out). NOTE: unlike a naive expectation, the auditory/visual islands do NOT hang off THAL alone here — MGN->A1 and LGN->V1 attach them to A1/V1 instead.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.AI: splits into TWO leaves on removal — NTS (NTS->AI only) and PI (PI->AI only).
mechanismOfEachArticulation.NAcc: on removal, isolates leaf VTA (VTA->NAcc only out) and leaf VP (NAcc->VP only), each a sub-piece of the reward island.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.OFC: on removal, isolates the reward sub-island {VTA, NAcc, VP} — because OFC->vmPFC is the reward island's only thread to the body, OFC is a second articulation point for the same cluster as vmPFC.
mechanismOfEachArticulation.GP: sole attachment of leaf STRI (STRI->GP is STRI's only outward link; STRI reaches the body only via GP->THAL).

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the visual thalamo-cortico-thalamic loop that THAL->V1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->V1 (excit, visual sensory relay). V1->LGN/pulvinar corticothalamic feedback is one of the most numerous projection classes in the brain (feedback outnumbers feedforward), functionally gain/precision control -> modul. canonical-nodes V1 = 'primary visual processing', THAL = motif M4 'gating relay / routing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the auditory thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->A1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->A1 (excit, auditory sensory relay). A1->MGN corticothalamic feedback is canonical and modulatory. canonical-nodes A1 = 'primary auditory processing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Corticothalamic feedback closing the somatosensory thalamo-cortical loop that THAL->S1 opens.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge THAL->S1 (excit, somatosensory relay). Layer-6 corticothalamic feedback S1->VPL is canonical, gain/precision control -> modul. canonical-nodes S1 = 'primary somatosensory processing'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the salience-network loop; the two salience hubs must be mutually coupled to co-select what gets escalated.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge AI->dACC (excit, 'interoceptive -> conflict monitor'). canonical-nodes AI = M10 'interoceptive salience', dACC = M6 'conflict/error monitor'; the anterior insula and dorsal ACC are the two defining hubs of the salience network and are reciprocally coupled by definition.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the value<->context loop; the context/valuation brake feeds back onto outcome valuation. Reciprocal of the existing OFC->vmPFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge OFC->vmPFC (excit). canonical-nodes vmPFC = M1 'top-down inhibitory brake', OFC = M6 'outcome valuation / update'; they are adjacent medial/orbital PFC regions with dense reciprocal connectivity.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the valuation<->reward loop; the outcome-valuation stage feeds forward-and-back to the reward driver. Reciprocal of the existing NAcc->OFC edge.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge NAcc->OFC (excit). The orbitofrontal cortex is a principal glutamatergic corticostriatal input to the ventral striatum / nucleus accumbens (canonical OFC->NAcc projection). canonical-nodes OFC = M6 valuation, NAcc = M11 'incentive/reward drive'.

proposedFeedbackEdges.rationale: Closes the threat<->salience loop that dACC->BLA opens: the counterintelligence threat node feeds the conflict monitor, and the monitor tags the threat.
proposedFeedbackEdges.grounding: Reciprocity of existing edge dACC->BLA (excit, 'salience tags threat'). The basolateral amygdala sends a dense projection to the anterior cingulate cortex (canonical amygdalo-cingulate pathway). canonical-nodes BLA = M7 'threat learning/acquisition', dACC = M6 conflict monitor.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The basal-ganglia output pair {STRI, GP} reaches the main body only via GP->THAL, so removing THAL isolates it; and STRI reaches the body only via STRI->GP, so removing GP isolates STRI. A direct corticostriatal edge reattaches STRI (and via STRI->GP, GP) independently of both THAL and GP. De-articulates GP entirely and removes the {STRI,GP} arm from THAL's cut-set.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes dlPFC = 'dorsolateral PFC — executive / cognitive control', STRI = striatum (basal-ganglia input). The dorsolateral-PFC -> dorsal-striatum corticostriatal projection is one of the canonical cortico-basal-ganglia input channels. GP = M4 'basal-ganglia output gate'.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: FEF reaches the graph only via FEF->V1, so removing V1 isolates it. A frontal-eye-field -> intraparietal-sulcus edge gives FEF a second anchor; removing V1 then leaves FEF attached via IPS. (V1 remains a residual articulation point for the dedicated LGN relay — see omissions.)
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes FEF = 'frontal eye fields — attentional gaze control', IPS = 'intraparietal sulcus — spatial attention & magnitude'. FEF and IPS are the two poles of the dorsal attention network and are densely interconnected (frontoparietal attention circuit).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The interoceptive island {AI, NTS, PI} reaches the main body only via AI->dACC, so removing dACC isolates the whole island. An anterior-insula -> orbitofrontal edge gives the island a second bridge; removing dACC then leaves {AI, NTS, PI} attached via OFC.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: The anterior insula projects to the orbitofrontal cortex, carrying interoceptive/gustatory signal into valuation (canonical insula->OFC pathway). canonical-nodes AI = M10 interoceptive salience, OFC = M6 valuation. (Same de-articulation edge used in the Finance recommendation.)

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: HYPO reaches the graph only via PVN->HYPO, so removing PVN isolates it. A hypothalamic -> periaqueductal-gray efferent gives HYPO a second anchor to a main-body node; removing PVN then leaves HYPO attached via PAG.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes HYPO = M3 'homeostatic set-point', PAG = M8 'defensive kill/lockdown'. The hypothalamus (esp. medial/dorsomedial) sends a canonical descending projection to the periaqueductal gray as part of the defensive/autonomic column. PAG is a main-body node (target of BLA->PAG, vmPFC->PAG).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: HPA reaches the graph only via HPA->HIPP, so removing HIPP isolates it. Cortisol also acts on the amygdala, giving HPA a second, well-grounded anchor; removing HIPP then leaves HPA attached via BLA.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: Glucocorticoid (HPA-axis) output acts on the basolateral amygdala via glucocorticoid receptors, enhancing threat processing (textbook stress endocrinology). canonical-nodes BLA = M7 'threat learning/acquisition'. NOTE: as in Finance, HPA is a composite/axis view rather than a clean single node; the cleaner long-run fix is to remap HPA to a view rather than treat it as a graph node.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: AI splits into TWO leaves on removal: PI (PI->AI only) and NTS (NTS->AI only). This edge reattaches the PI leaf: a posterior-insula -> cingulate interoceptive edge gives PI a second anchor. Paired with the NTS->PVN edge below, it fully de-articulates AI.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes PI = M10 'primary interoception', dACC = M6 conflict monitor / salience hub. Posterior/mid-insula interoceptive signals project to the anterior cingulate as part of the interoception-salience pathway.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Reattaches AI's second leaf, NTS (NTS->AI only). A visceral-afferent -> hypothalamus edge gives NTS a second anchor; removing AI then leaves NTS attached via PVN. Together with PI->dACC this drops AI from the articulation set.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes NTS = M10 'visceral afferent hub'. The nucleus tractus solitarius sends a canonical ascending projection to the paraventricular nucleus of the hypothalamus (visceral-afferent -> autonomic/neuroendocrine relay). PVN is an in-graph node (target of mPFC->PVN, BLA->PVN, HIPP->PVN, LC->PVN).

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: VP reaches the graph only via NAcc->VP, so removing NAcc isolates it. A ventral-pallidum -> VTA GABAergic edge gives VP a second anchor and closes the mesolimbic reward loop VTA->NAcc->VP->VTA (the hedonic-output stage feeds back to regulate the dopamine source). One edge serves both recurrence and redundancy.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: In-graph the reward chain VTA->NAcc (excit) and NAcc->VP (inhib) already exists; the ventral pallidum sends GABAergic feedback to VTA (canonical mesolimbic disinhibition loop). canonical-nodes VP = 'ventral pallidum — reward/hedonic output', VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source'. (Same edge as the Finance recommendation.)

proposedRedundantPaths.aroundNode: vmPFC / OFC / NAcc (whole reward island — second thread to the body)
proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: The entire reward/valuation island {VTA, NAcc, VP, OFC} hangs off the main body by the SINGLE thread OFC->vmPFC, which is exactly why vmPFC, OFC and NAcc are all articulation points for it. A mesocortical dopamine projection from VTA to the executive hub dlPFC gives the island a SECOND, independent thread to the body: with it, removing vmPFC (or OFC) no longer isolates the island (it reattaches via VTA->dlPFC), and removing NAcc leaves VTA attached via VTA->dlPFC (and VP via VP->VTA). This single canonical edge de-articulates vmPFC and OFC and completes the NAcc fix.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes VTA = M11 'dopamine reward source', dlPFC = 'dorsolateral PFC — executive / cognitive control'. The VTA mesocortical dopaminergic projection to prefrontal cortex is textbook (the mesocortical DA pathway). modul because dopamine sets gain, not detailed content.

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: EXTRA-FAULT FIX (not a classic articulation node). {SMA, M1} is a fully disconnected component at baseline. A corticostriatal edge reattaches the dyad to the main body (STRI is a main-body node), reducing baseComponents 2->1. Paired with THAL->M1 below so the dyad has TWO independent bridges and STRI/GP do not become a NEW single point of failure for it.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes SMA = 'supplementary motor — self-initiated action sequencing'; SMA is a principal cortical source of the motor corticostriatal projection to putamen/striatum (canonical). (Same reconnection edge as the Finance recommendation.)

proposedRedundantPaths.rationale: Second independent bridge for the disconnected {M1, SMA} dyad, so removing STRI/GP does not re-isolate it (prevents SMA->STRI from turning STRI into a new articulation node). Also the canonical final leg of the cortico-basal-ganglia-thalamo-cortical motor loop, whose output limb STRI->GP->THAL is already in-graph.
proposedRedundantPaths.grounding: canonical-nodes THAL = M4 'gating relay / routing', M1 = 'primary motor cortex — motor output'. The ventral-anterior/ventral-lateral thalamus -> M1 projection is the canonical thalamocortical motor relay and the return leg of the BG loop already half-present in-graph (STRI->GP inhib, GP->THAL inhib).

projectedImpact.method: The 18 proposed edges (7 feedback + 11 redundant/reconnection) were appended to a deep copy of intelligence.json in memory and re-scored with assets/js/energy-connectivity-audit.js. intelligence.json itself was NOT modified.

reciprocalEdges.note: the pre-existing pair dACC<->dlPFC plus the 7 proposedFeedbackEdges (each the reverse of a pre-existing edge) = 8 reciprocal pairs = 16 directed reciprocal edges.

recurrentFraction.note: lands exactly at the 0.2 tree-vs-mesh threshold; still far below the ~0.8 cortical benchmark, but crosses out of the feedforward-tree regime.

lateralFractionOfClassifiable.note: essentially unchanged; the proposed edges target feedback and reconnection, not lateral density (which already clears the threshold).

baseComponents.note: the {SMA, M1} dyad is reconnected by SMA->STRI + THAL->M1; the graph becomes a single connected body.

articulationNodes.reason: All three residual articulation points survive solely because a dedicated sensory/relay leaf has no second grounded projection target present in the graph, so its redundant path was omitted rather than fabricated: A1 still cuts off MGN; V1 still cuts off LGN; THAL still cuts off S1 and CBLM. This is the same honest floor Finance and Energy bottomed out at (dedicated LGN/MGN geniculate relays, cerebellar CBLM).

candidates.candidate: redundant path around THAL via a second edge on S1
candidates.reason: S1 reaches the graph only via THAL->S1. A second grounded target would be S1->M1 (dense reciprocal somatomotor connectivity), which IS groundable once M1 is reconnected to the main body — but it was NOT added because it would not clear THAL from the articulation set while the ungroundable CBLM leaf persists. Recorded as a groundable future edge, not an omission for lack of grounding, but left out of the applied set.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around THAL via a second edge on CBLM
candidates.reason: CBLM reaches the graph only via CBLM->THAL. The thalamus does not project to the cerebellum, and cerebellar cortical input arrives polysynaptically via the pontine nuclei (no direct cortex->CBLM fiber to any in-graph node). No honest second edge, so CBLM stays a leaf of THAL and THAL stays a residual articulation point for it. (Same floor as Energy/Finance.)

candidates.candidate: redundant path around A1 via a second edge on MGN
candidates.reason: MGN is a dedicated cochlea-recipient (medial geniculate) auditory thalamic relay whose only cortical target is A1; no second grounded projection target exists among the graph's nodes. MGN stays a leaf of A1.

candidates.candidate: redundant path around V1 via a second edge on LGN
candidates.reason: LGN is a dedicated retino-recipient thalamic relay whose only cortical target is V1; the pulvinar / superior-colliculus partners that would give it a second grounded projection are not present as nodes in the intelligence graph. LGN stays a leaf of V1.

Hippocampal output to lateral PFC is not a monosynaptic projection; direct hippocampal-PFC fibers target mPFC/vmPFC, not dlPFC, and the mPFC relay is not on an intelligence-graph edge path. Cannot ground a direct HIPP->dlPFC edge. (Same omission as Finance.)

_omittedForLackOfGrounding.notedButNotOmitted: The reward island's single thread was the sharpest structural risk; it is fully addressed by the grounded VTA->dlPFC (mesocortical) + VP->VTA (mesolimbic) pair, so no ungrounded reward-island edge was needed.
